payload.claim: The `uncollected` docstring in saffron/gates/contract.py (line 81-82) promises `revert` 'reads this back for that subset alone', but the note built here uses the raw `listed = set(reverted_result.uncollected)` unfiltered by `handed`/`subset`, not the subset-restricted portion. The diff's own `dropped_both` test case (tests/test_revert.py) constructs a reverted run whose `uncollected` contains a name that was never handed (a dropped `--deselect=` option, filtered out by `_argv_safe` before `run_tests` was ever called) while every actually-handed name is already accounted for via `collected`; under that input this code still appends '1 handed name(s) the reverted run could not collect' naming that never-handed option string, even though no handed name was in fact left uncollected. No test asserts the note's content in that case, so the false claim is invisible to the gate suite.
